cause_quote: The feature set `environmentFailure` from a failed status read and rendered `t(failed ? "portalsPage.environmentUnavailable" ...)` with `environmentUnavailable: "The machine could not start..."` for both read errors and any status other than starting/available.
user_saw: The Portal panel beside a conversation said the device could not start when only the status check had failed or the device was stopping or unavailable, with a retry button that only re-read status.
summary: Gives the Portal pending-device panel distinct messages for a failed status read, a stopping device, and an unavailable device, and relabels the recovery button "Check again".
reasoning: The conflation dates to 4d62efeccf7 (#152094), which introduced the pending-environment panel and mapped any status-read error or non-starting/available status to the single 'machine could not start' message; 7fb4e046d7bf and 6afa9c60f62c only moved the logic and reworded the same string. It is a wrong-diagnosis presentation bug rather than broken function, so confidence is medium and it sits close to a copy change.
